subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 42

text: Trustee, Huntington Beach City School District
The California Republican Party, California Republican Assembly, California Congress of Republicans and Reform California have all endorsed my candidacy.
I am a lifelong Republican and local elected Trustee in Huntington Beach. I have a proven conservative record as I have consistently stood for common sense and fought for my constituents.

The 42nd District was drastically gerrymandered due to Prop 50. I entered this race because we needed a responsible elected official to represent the conservative cause for Congress in this new district.

During a time when many school districts are cutting costs and contemplating layoffs to balance budgets, Huntington Beach City School District has set a new standard for excellence. We have balanced budgets, built reserves, safeguarded your tax dollars and kept our schools safe.
Californians are currently confronting the reality of absurdly high taxes, increased crime and an affordability crisis resulting in rising poverty and high inflation.

Tax relief for businesses and families is a top priority. I will advocate for tax credits to help first-time homeowners. I have protected our children from extreme political agendas and I will take that same no-nonsense approach to Congress in the fight against socialism.

Experience matters - My background is in information technology as I administer Learning Management Systems at the University of Southern California. I also hold multiple degrees from USC including a Master’s in Public Policy.
I respectfully ask for your vote in this upcoming election.
Learn More at BrianBurley.com
Vote Republican Brian Burley for Congress!

text: United States Congressman
From Long Beach to Orange County, everyone in our community wants the same things: A safe community. A better future for our kids. Leaders who focus on helping working families.
During my two terms in Congress, I have kept these principles at the center of every vote I have taken and every bill I have introduced.
My priorities include:

Creating good paying jobs and lowering costs
Keeping our communities safe
Improving public education
Protecting the environment and our coast
Affordable housing & health care
Fighting government corruption
My record of results:

Working with local governments, I have helped secure over $500 million in federal grants for programs and projects including infrastructure improvements, environmental initiatives, community health care programs, and public safety support.
I have assisted more than 20,000 local residents who needed help with federal agencies including Passport Services, Veterans Affairs, Social Security, Immigration support and the IRS.

As the new lead Democrat on the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, I help lead investigations into government corruption, including the release of the Epstein Files. We are also focused on modernizing government services so the Federal Government can serve our community better and more efficiently.
My endorsements include California’s firefighters, teachers, health care workers and over 100 members of Congress and local officials.
I would be honored to receive your vote. Thank you.
